gtm.title: GTM — Galaxy Training Manager
gtm.tagline: A training tracking app built during my introductory internship at Galaxy Solutions (2025–2026).
gtm.summary: Track courses, sessions, and registrations with a dashboard and exports. Demo data are fictional.

olist.title: E-commerce Data Audit — Olist
olist.tagline: Final analysis dataset: 96,252 orders from a Brazilian marketplace.
olist.summary: A study of delivery times, customer reviews, and data quality in the Olist dataset.

afc.title: Correspondence Analysis (CA)
afc.tagline: A study of links between professional fields and skills in LinkedIn job ads.
afc.summary: A descriptive statistical method applied with Python to job ads.

acp.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
acp.tagline: An exploratory analysis of 169 countries using nine socio-economic and health indicators.
acp.summary: PCA highlights the main contrasts between indicators, with 63.86% of inertia explained by the first two axes.

revision-flow.title: RevisionFlow
revision-flow.tagline: A web app to plan study time and track sessions.
revision-flow.summary: An adjustable study plan with a calendar, backlog, and Pomodoro timer.

sante-scolaire.title: SantéScolaire
sante-scolaire.tagline: A school health app with different access roles.
sante-scolaire.summary: Manage student records, visits, and appointments. Demo data are fictional.

novastore.title: NovaStore
novastore.tagline: An online-store prototype built by a team of five.
novastore.summary: Product list, cart, and printable invoice. My main contribution was designing and implementing the app; payment is simulated.

pneumonia-detection.title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-rays — Deep Learning
pneumonia-detection.tagline: Team academic project comparing a custom CNN with DenseNet121 transfer learning.
pneumonia-detection.summary: NORMAL / PNEUMONIA classification on 5,856 chest X-rays, with reported metrics and source discrepancies documented.

goodthought-sql-analysis.title: SQL Analysis of Donations and Impact — GoodThought
goodthought-sql-analysis.tagline: Guided DataCamp project exploring donations and impact scores by assignment and region.
goodthought-sql-analysis.summary: SQL queries on assignments, donations, and donors in a practice case, using aggregations, CTEs, and regional rankings.

motorcycle-parts-sales.title: Motorcycle Parts Sales Analysis
motorcycle-parts-sales.tagline: Guided DataCamp project analysing wholesale sales by product, month, and warehouse.
motorcycle-parts-sales.summary: SQL queries on 1,000 practice orders, grouped by product line, month, and warehouse.

students-mental-health.title: Analyzing Students’ Mental Health
students-mental-health.tagline: Guided DataCamp project comparing scores by student status and length of stay.
students-mental-health.summary: SQL analysis of PHQ-9, SCS, and ASISS scores in a survey of students in Japan.
